summary: SIREN writes and plays endless electronic dance tracks on its own, with intros, builds, breaks and drops, while you steer it like a DJ. Version 0.10, experimental.
features: Eight styles from techno and trance to drum and bass and house
201 sounds over seven layers, including an OberVave engine port
Black keys trigger breaks, builds, drops, fills and key changes
White keys take over any layer; hold-to-play DJ effects page
16 saved seeds replay a track; shareable seed codes
SIREN STUDIO browser app for live control and sound choice
